item.title: [AU/ASIC] 26-286MR ASIC to target cost of living and tech-related consumer harm in 2027
item.description: ASIC will target financial misconduct that adds to cost of living pressures and the use of AI and other technology that causes consumer harm as part of its new enforcement priorities for 2027 .

item.title: [SG/MAS] Future of Finance Institute Commences Operations, Starting with AI in Finance
item.description: MAS announced that the Future of Finance Institute (FFI) has commenced operations, following the June 2026 announcement of its establishment. FFI aims to accelerate the adoption of new financial technologies and catalyse innovation in the financial sector.

item.description: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) today (2 November) launched the Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Toolkit (Toolkit), with support from industry participants. item.description: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) today (2 November) co-organised the Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 with Invest Hong Kong. item.title: [HK/HKMA] HKMA launches Project SAGE and establishes Expert Group for agentic finance
item.description: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced today (2 November) the launch of Project SAGE to support the responsible development and adoption of agentic finance in Hong Kong.

item.title: [AU/ASIC] 26-201MR ASIC and APRA warn frontier AI awareness must turn to action
item.description: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) and the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority (APRA) are urging financial market entities to move from gaining awareness of risks linked to frontier AI to taking decisive action.

item.title: [AU/ASIC] 26-244MR Fortnum Private Wealth penalised $1.35 million for cybersecurity failures
item.description: Fortnum Private Wealth Ltd has been ordered by the Supreme Court of NSW to pay a $1.35 million penalty after admitting it failed to adequately manage cybersecurity risks across its financial advice network.

item.title: [SG/MAS] MAS Sets Out Supervisory Expectations on Responsible AI Adoption by Financial Institutions
item.description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore today issued a set of Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management to support responsible AI adoption in Singapore’s financial sector.

item.title: [AU/ASIC] 26-226MR ASIC strengthens AI trading safeguards and streamlines market integrity rules
item.description: ASIC is strengthening safeguards for automated and AI-enabled trading while streamlining regulatory requirements for securities and futures market participants under incoming changes to its Market Integrity Rules (MIRs).

item.title: [SG/MAS] MAS and ABS Establish Taskforce to Strengthen Cyber and Technology Resilience against AI-driven Threats
item.description: MAS and ABS announced the establishment of the AI-Driven Cyber and Technology Risk Taskforce (ACT), an industry-wide initiative to strengthen collective cyber and technology resilience in response to the emerging risks posed by frontier AI models.

item.title: [SG/MAS] Monetary Authority of Singapore and Bank of Thailand Sign Memorandum of Understanding on Cybersecurity Cooperation and Digital Fraud Protection
item.description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore and the Bank of Thailand signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cybersecurity Cooperation and Digital Fraud Protection.
